protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Murine-equivalent schedule only: 625 mcg twice daily (1,250 mcg/day) weeks 1–2, then 1,250 mcg twice daily (2,500 mcg/day) weeks 3–8. Based on a ~25 g mouse, not a human dose. 5 mg + 3 mL is reference math; small molecule, not a peptide, preclinical only.
